parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `ReviewRequestServiceTests.recordPlaybackStartedIncrementsCount` (line 22) and `ReviewRequestServiceTests.recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactoring action should be taken. Although the two test methods share a similar shape (Jaccard 0.75), collapsing them into a generic helper would obscure the distinct domain events under test (`recordPlaybackStarted` vs. `recordSongAddedToLibrary`) and could reduce test clarity and failure diagnostics.
